mapper.insert: INSERT INTO draw_count_purchase_order (purchase_order_id, user_id, quantity, points_cost, state, retry_count, next_retry_at, finish_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{purchaseOrderId}, #{userId}, #{quantity}, #{pointsCost}, #{state}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryAt}, #{finishTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, purchase_order_id, user_id, quantity, points_cost, state, retry_count, next_retry_at, finish_time, create_time, update_time FROM draw_count_purchase_order WHERE purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId}

SELECT id, purchase_order_id, user_id, quantity, points_cost, state, retry_count, next_retry_at, finish_time, create_time, update_time FROM draw_count_purchase_order WHERE state = 0 AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW()) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE draw_count_purchase_order SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 0 AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW())
UPDATE draw_count_purchase_order SET state = 1, finish_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} AND state <> 1
UPDATE draw_count_purchase_order SET state = 2, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 0
